# Staff training for Fernbank circulation screens

Two-hour sessions at Main Street for all circulation staff in the first week of March, before [[Project Kestrel]] goes live.

Topics: checking items in and out, placing holds for patrons, reading the new patron block messages, and printing receipts. Fernbank prints due dates on the receipt in a different format than Bookwright did, so staff should point that out to patrons at the desk.

Bring a test patron card. Sessions are recorded for staff who work weekends and cannot attend in person.
